title: S025 3.7.3 Interfaces with Variable MTU Values
parent_path: S025 3.7.3 Interfaces with Variable MTU Values

statements.subject: tcp
statements.description: As a result, when the effective MTU of an interface varies packet-to-packet, TCP implementations SHOULD use the smallest effective MTU of the interface to calculate the value to advertise in the MSS Option (SHLD-6).
